The '''Seidhkona system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seidhkona]].
